info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Public Reference Data Update API
info.description: The Public Reference Data Update API enables organizations to efficiently modify and manage reference data within the banking sector. Utilizing this API, users can update specific market data related to public reference entities, ensuring that information remains accurate and current. Typical consumers include financial institutions and data management teams that rely on up-to-date market information for regulatory compliance and decision-making. The endpoint provides essential tools to adapt to market changes swiftly and maintain data integrity.
